overview_description.description: Clarity AI is a sustainability technology platform that uses machine learning and big data to deliver environmental and social insights to investors and organizations. As of December 2021, Clarity AI’s platform analyzes more than 30,000 companies, 135,000 funds, 198 countries and 187 local governments, and delivers data and analytics for investing, corporate research and reporting. Clarity AI has offices in the US and Europe. Clarity AI’s client network manages trillions in assets under management.

about_short_description.short_description: Clarity AI is a sustainability technology platform that uses machine learning to deliver environmental and social insights to investors.

product.name: Clarity AI Platform
product.description: An AI-native platform that converts environmental, social, governance, climate, impact, and other extra-financial data into insights for financial and business decisions.

product.name: ESG Risk Analytics
product.description: Analytics for assessing ESG risks and exposures across companies, funds, and portfolios, including ratings, controversies, global norms, and sector or business-activity exposure.

product.name: Climate and Nature Analytics
product.description: Climate and nature intelligence for measuring portfolio exposure, transition and physical risks, carbon footprints, biodiversity impacts, and alignment with climate scenarios.

product.name: Regulatory Compliance Analytics
product.description: Data and analytics that support sustainable-finance classifications, disclosures, and suitability processes under frameworks such as SFDR, the EU Taxonomy, MiFID II, and Pillar 3.

product.name: Impact Analytics
product.description: Portfolio impact measurement and reporting tools covering real-world outcomes, UN Sustainable Development Goals alignment, and impact-related climate and nature metrics.

product.name: Sustainability Data Solutions
product.description: Raw and processed extra-financial datasets, data collection, and data management services covering companies, funds, sovereigns, asset classes, and portfolio types.
